aria-label.zh-CN: 按钮的可访问名称，只有图标没有文字的按钮需要设置。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the button, needed when it shows only an icon.

block.zh-CN: 将按钮设置为块级按钮。
block.en-US: Renders the button as a block-level button.

className.zh-CN: 原生 button 元素的类名。
className.en-US: Class name of the native button element.

colorful.zh-CN: 多彩按钮，仅支持 primary 与 tertiary 类型；图标元素会获得多彩填充。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，不在组内时为 `false`。
colorful.en-US: Colorful button, supported for the primary and tertiary types only; the icon element receives the colorful fill. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and to `false` outside a group.

contentClassName.en-US: Class name of the content area.

disabled.zh-CN: 禁用状态，优先于 loading。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，不在组内时为 `false`。
disabled.en-US: Disabled state, which takes precedence over loading. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and to `false` outside a group.

htmlType.zh-CN: 原生 button 的 type 值，可选 `button`、`reset` 或 `submit`。
htmlType.en-US: Native type of the button: `button`, `reset` or `submit`.

id.zh-CN: 原生 button 元素的 id。
id.en-US: Id of the native button element.

loading.zh-CN: 加载状态。加载中按钮保持可聚焦，点击不触发 onClick，submit 按钮也不提交表单。
loading.en-US: Loading state. A loading button stays focusable, its onClick is ignored, and a submit button does not submit its form.

noHorizontalPadding.zh-CN: 去掉水平方向的内边距，可选 `true`、`left`、`right` 或二者的数组；只对设置了图标或处于加载状态的按钮有效。
noHorizontalPadding.en-US: Removes horizontal padding: `true`, `left`, `right` or an array of both. Applies only to a button that shows an icon or the loading spinner.

onClick.zh-CN: 单击按钮时调用；禁用或加载中不调用。
onClick.en-US: Called when the button is clicked; not called while disabled or loading.

onMouseDown.en-US: Called when the mouse button is pressed on the button.

onMouseEnter.en-US: Called when the pointer enters the button.

onMouseLeave.en-US: Called when the pointer leaves the button.

ref.zh-CN: 原生 button 元素的引用。
ref.en-US: Reference to the native button element.

size.zh-CN: 按钮尺寸，可选 `large`、`default` 或 `small`。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，不在组内时为 `default`。
size.en-US: Button size: `large`, `default` or `small`. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and to `default` outside a group.

style.zh-CN: 原生 button 元素的样式。
style.en-US: Style of the native button element.

theme.zh-CN: 按钮主题，可选 `solid`、`borderless`、`light` 或 `outline`。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，不在组内时为 `light`。
theme.en-US: Button theme: `solid`, `borderless`, `light` or `outline`. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and to `light` outside a group.

type.zh-CN: 按钮类型，可选 `primary`、`secondary`、`tertiary`、`warning` 或 `danger`。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，不在组内时为 `primary`。
type.en-US: Button type: `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `warning` or `danger`. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and to `primary` outside a group.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

colorful.zh-CN: 多彩样式，作为组内按钮的默认值。
colorful.en-US: Colorful style, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

disabled.zh-CN: 禁用状态，作为组内按钮的默认值。
disabled.en-US: Disabled state, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

size.zh-CN: 按钮尺寸，作为组内按钮的默认值。
size.en-US: Button size, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

theme.zh-CN: 按钮主题，作为组内按钮的默认值。
theme.en-US: Button theme, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

type.zh-CN: 按钮类型，作为组内按钮的默认值。
type.en-US: Button type, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

aria-label.zh-CN: 分裂按钮组的可访问名称。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the split button group.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.
